lines.text: You once spoke in a vision;
to Your godly ones You said,
“I have bestowed help on a warrior;
I have exalted one chosen from the people.
I have found My servant David;
with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
surely My arm will strengthen him.
no wicked man will oppress him.
I will crush his foes before him
and strike down those who hate him.
My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him,
and through My name his horn will be exalted.
I will set his hand over the sea,
and his right hand upon the rivers.
He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father,
my God, the Rock of my salvation.’

pictures.scene: Anton Raphael Mengs, The Dream of Saint Joseph — the sleeping man with the angel bending close to speak to him in the night, and our king to the Holy One of Israel, You once spoke in a vision
pictures.name: pd_mengs_visioen

pictures.scene: Jules Bastien-Lepage, Joan of Arc — the farm girl standing up from her stool in the garden with her hand out, hearing what has just been said to her, to Your godly ones You said, I have bestowed help on a warrior
pictures.name: pd_bastienlepage_krijgsman

pictures.scene: Andrea del Castagno, The Youthful David — the shepherd boy painted on the leather shield, striding out with the sling still in his hand, I have exalted one chosen from the people, I have found My servant David
pictures.name: pd_castagno_gevonden

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, The Anointment of David — Samuel tipping the horn of oil over the young man's head while the household looks on, with My sacred oil I have anointed him, My hand will sustain him
pictures.name: pd_veronese_gezalfd

pictures.scene: Masaccio, The Tribute Money — the tax collector held off with one hand while Peter is sent to find the coin, surely My arm will strengthen him, no enemy will exact tribute
pictures.name: pd_masaccio_schatting

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Surrender of Breda — the beaten commander handing over the key and the victor stopping him from kneeling, no wicked man will oppress him, I will crush his foes before him
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_vijanden

pictures.scene: Julius Schnorr von Carolsfeld, Ruth im Feld des Boaz — the foreign woman standing in the barley with her arms full and the master of the field speaking kindly to her, and strike down those who hate him, My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him
pictures.name: pd_schnorr_trouw

pictures.scene: Claude-Joseph Vernet, L'entrée du port de Marseille — the whole harbour working under the morning light with the ships coming in past the point, and through My name his horn will be exalted, I will set his hand over the sea
pictures.name: pd_vernet_zee

pictures.scene: Joachim Patinir, The Baptism of Christ — the Son standing in the river while the Father's voice comes down out of the opened sky, and his right hand upon the rivers, He will call to Me, You are my Father
pictures.name: pd_patinir_vader

pictures.scene: Thomas Fearnley, The Grindelwald Glacier — the bare wall of rock and ice standing over the valley, older and harder than anything beneath it, my God, the Rock of my salvation, I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn
pictures.name: pd_fearnley_rots
